messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing slightly right, then raises a hand to the forehead and head, tilts the head back, and finally lowers the arm to stand upright.","camera":"Static medium-to-full shot at eye level, framing the character centered with the background visible on both sides.","clothing":"Wears a mustard-yellow cable-knit sweater, blue jeans, and brown lace-up shoes with yellow socks.","hair_color":"Light brown.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a small top bun with a few loose strands at the temples.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young adult with a slim build and light brown skin, shown from the waist up at first and full body later.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a swing ride on the left, a carousel-style structure with lights on the right, and a striped canopy cart nearby."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a front three-quarter upper-body framing matching the reference, with the character centered and the amusement park visible on both sides. The character performs the same head/forehead-touching motion and then stands upright. The camera later pulls back to include the full body, so the final frames are no longer strictly upper-body.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, timing, and environment.
uncertain: Whether the later full-body framing was intended as part of the camera movement or is an unintended deviation.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing changes from upper-body to a full-body shot by the end of the video.
